newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA barley export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Sales of 42,100 MT for delivery in the 1997/98 MY, which began June 1, were for Mexico (32,100 MT) and unknown destinations (10,000 MT).
A total of 85,600 MT in sales were carried over from the 1996/97 MY, which ended May 31.

Exports for May 30-31 of 2,000 MT--all to Mexico--brought accumulated exports to 618,600 MT, down 57 percent from the 1,446,800 MT exported during 1995/96. Exports of 9,500 MT for June 1-5 were to Mexico.
